quest.title: Gift and Intent
quest.description: Noelle has, as is her wont, extended a helping hand to Bea, who is facing a bit of a romantic quandary. After some discussion, you decide to use a gift to help Bea get her feelings across...

talks.objective: Make a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: How am I ever going to get Quinn to listen to me...?

talks.objective: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: What's... what's this? Not an attractive sight...

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Smells a little strange, too... Surely this can't be what you want me give to Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'll keep waiting for you here then.

talks.objective: Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea
Give a serving of Mondstadt Grilled Fish to Bea

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Uh... Mondstadt Grilled Fish... for Quinn?

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: I have often said that I would bring him lunch... Would this really work? Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Beatrice
dialogues.text: Well, since it's Noelle's recommendation, I'll give it a try!

dialogues.speaker: Noelle's Study Notes
dialogues.text: #"Make time to be together alone," "Give {F#her}{M#him} a cake you made yourself"...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle's Study Notes
dialogues.text: Words of counsel and wisdom are penned here in a lovely hand that unfortunately grew shaky towards the tail end.

dialogues.speaker: Noelle's Study Notes
dialogues.text: Some of the text has been arbitrarily struck out, seemingly a result of the owner's emotions suddenly running high.

talks.objective: Look for Noelle in the library

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Whew! All these b—books have got my heart racing...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: I think I should take a break and do something else... to distract myself...

dialogues.speaker: Noelle
dialogues.text: Then again, perhaps I should finish this one first. Just the one, right?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Fruit, fresh fruit... want some fruit?

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Oh... she said something about giving me something to eat... but I'm really not hungry right now...

dialogues.speaker: Quinn
dialogues.text: Besides, she's constantly talking about bringing me lunch, so I didn't think anything of it this time...
